nodes.name: Note: how to read this workflow

parameters.content:
## HARSLL – Dispatcher: take in a file
Called by the Dispatcher once for each spreadsheet that has stopped changing. Gets the file name and the settings; returns when the file is dealt with.

- **Top row:** unsafe file name, so staff are asked (once) to rename it
- **Middle row:** read the rows, record one case per new row (a referred case may be reopened), record the batch, archive the file
- **Lower rows:** unreadable file (retried a few times) or wrong layout, so it is moved to rejected and staff are emailed

## Take in one file
The three steps after "Link rows of the same tenancy" run top to bottom: record new cases, reopen earlier cases, then record the batch and archive the file. Keep that vertical order.
